races.paceDynamic: Travis will lead uncontested from the gates with only Straight A, The Sweet Escape, Thats My Boy Luke and Electric Lightning showing prominent tendencies - none are natural pace-pressers. This sets up a comfortable tempo that will allow Travis to dictate terms through honest fractions without being harried. The large contingent of hold-up horses including Up The Jazz, Mariner, Chuzzlewit, Kiss Me My Love, Thequietman, We've Got This, Hachiman and Whiskey Pete will be tracking behind, creating a bunched field that will need the pace to quicken significantly in the final 2f to catch the leader. This tactical setup strongly favours front-runners and prominent racers who can avoid the traffic and secure good positions early.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Travis Controls Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Travis gets an easy lead and maintains his kick
scenarios.body: The uncontested leader sets honest fractions and has enough in reserve to resist the late charge from the hold-up brigade. His recent form suggests he stays this trip well when allowed to dictate.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pair Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent horses press forward leaving Travis isolated
scenarios.body: Straight A and The Sweet Escape get first run on Travis in the straight while the hold-up horses are still organising their challenges. The duo's better recent form tells in a tactical affair.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Heroes Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes overly steady and the field compresses
scenarios.body: Up The Jazz and Mariner get the perfect setup for their running style with plenty of pace to aim at late. Their class edges show when getting the right race shape.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Chaos In Straight
scenarios.trigger: If Travis stops quickly and the prominent horses falter
scenarios.body: The large pack of hold-up horses creates a cavalry charge with traffic problems and hard luck stories. Electric Lightning's 3lb claimer finds a clear path through the mayhem.

watchPoints.text: Travis could get too easy a lead early and have too much left for the closers to peg back
Up The Jazz and Mariner need the pace to be strong enough to bring their hold-up style into play effectively
The Sweet Escape and Straight A represent the main threats to Travis from prominent positions
Thequietman's 108-day absence makes him hard to assess despite his higher official rating
Electric Lightning's 3lb claiming allowance could prove decisive in a tight finish

races.paceDynamic: Bergamo Gold will take the field along at a steady gallop from the front, with Fanciulla Del West and Letmeseethecolts providing some company in the early stages before settling prominent. With limited early pace pressure, Bergamo Gold can dictate terms and bowl along at a comfortable rhythm that should see the field still in contention turning for home. The sustainable tempo will allow the hold-up horses like Myrrh, Fire Eyes, Princess Niyla, Ammoony, Clocker and Eze Sur Mer to get into contention, but crucially they'll need to make up significant ground in the straight. This pace scenario clearly favours the prominent runners and the lone front-runner who can control the gallop without getting into a speed duel.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Front Running
scenarios.trigger: If Bergamo Gold gets an easy lead and kicks clear turning in
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace allows Bergamo Gold to save energy for a telling move, while the hold-up brigade get caught flat-footed by the change of gear. Fanciulla Del West and Letmeseethecolts can track the move from their prominent positions.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays steady throughout and multiple closers get clear runs
scenarios.body: Fire Eyes and Myrrh benefit from their proven ability at this trip, timing their challenges perfectly as Bergamo Gold weakens. The even gallop plays into the hands of horses with a devastating turn of foot.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Victory
scenarios.trigger: If Fanciulla Del West or Letmeseethecolts get first run on the leader
scenarios.body: Their prominent position allows them to strike before the hold-up horses can organize, capitalizing on being closest to the early pace. The front-runner gets outpaced by fresher legs that have been tracking.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Bergamo Gold sets pedestrian fractions and gets run down by everything
scenarios.body: The slow tempo turns it into a sprint finish where any horse can win regardless of position. Class and current form become the deciding factors rather than tactical positioning.

watchPoints.text: Bergamo Gold may get an uncontested lead if Fanciulla Del West and Letmeseethecolts settle too far back early
Fire Eyes showed his best form recently at this track but needs a strong pace to be effective from his hold-up style
Ammoony has the highest recent RPR but Tom Clover's poor strike rate suggests stable confidence may be low
Princess Niyla's headgear addition and quick return suggests connections are concerned about her current form
Letmeseethecolts returning after over a year off makes his fitness level completely unpredictable despite proven course form

races.paceDynamic: Lumenbourg and Lindoro will contest the early lead, with Lumenbourg showing more natural pace and likely to take them along at a good clip over this sharp 6f. The prominent runners Lord Abama, Get Up Everybody and Taygar will track the pace closely, creating a bunched group entering the final two furlongs. This honest gallop will stretch the field and expose the hold-up horses who rely on a strong finish. The race shape clearly favours prominent racers and those with early pace, as the two front-runners will ensure no soft lead and the strong gallop will make it difficult for hold-up horses to pick up the pieces.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is honest but not suicidal, allowing prominent runners to stay in touch
scenarios.body: The strong gallop stretches the field but doesn't burn out the pace-tracking horses. Prominent runners like Get Up Everybody and Taygar can kick from good positions as the leaders tire.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If one of the leaders gets first run on the field and maintains momentum
scenarios.body: Lumenbourg or Lindoro establishes a slight advantage entering the final furlong. The honest pace means hold-up horses can't quite get there in time.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Rally
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes too strong and burns out the leaders completely
scenarios.body: The dual between Lumenbourg and Lindoro becomes too fierce, setting up the race for closers. Glory Hyde and One Of Our Own benefit from their patient tactics as the pace collapses.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Speed Surprise Victory
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is surprisingly moderate with both leaders restraining themselves
scenarios.body: A tactical affair develops where speed horses can conserve energy for a sustained finish. This allows a pace-setter to dominate or a well-positioned prominent runner to win easily.

watchPoints.text: Lumenbourg and Lindoro will be crucial pace-setters whose early duel intensity determines whether hold-up horses can get competitive
Get Up Everybody has been placed in both recent starts and drops back from trainer Paul Midgley who is hitting 21% strike rate
Glory Hyde won here last time out over 6f and returns quickly after just 6 days, suggesting connections are confident
One Of Our Own has won twice recently including at this track, but hold-up style faces tactical disadvantage against confirmed pace
Taygar showed improved form with recent second at Redcar for Michael Dods stable and Jason Hart retains the ride

races.paceDynamic: Harswell River will take the field along as the sole confirmed front runner, likely joined by prominent racers Perfect Ruler and Full Gas in the early stages. With eight hold-up horses behind them, this creates a clear pace scenario where the leaders won't face early pressure. The moderate early gallop should allow Harswell River to dictate terms while the large hold-up contingent will need to find racing room in the straight. This race shape strongly favours front runners and prominent racers who can avoid the inevitable traffic problems that will engulf the hold-up horses.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Harswell River maintains a sustainable lead without early pressure from the prominent duo
scenarios.body: The pace-setter can kick clear turning for home while the massed ranks of hold-up horses get tangled up behind. This becomes a procession for those who secured the best early positions.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pair Strike
scenarios.trigger: If Perfect Ruler and Full Gas track Harswell River closely and time their challenges perfectly
scenarios.body: The Haggas and Ryan runners can use their class advantage to sweep past a tiring leader. Their prominent style avoids the hold-up horse traffic while positioning them to strike.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and clear running opens up down the outside
scenarios.body: The large group of closers can finally showcase their ability with Maximum Velocity and Forever Twenty leading the charge. This requires a pedestrian early tempo and fortune in running.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Meltdown Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If Harswell River goes too fast early or the prominent horses engage in a speed duel
scenarios.body: The race falls apart tactically with tired leaders and a bunched field creating a lottery finish. Any horse finding a clear passage can capitalise on the pace collapse.

watchPoints.text: Watch for traffic problems in the straight as eight hold-up horses converge on limited racing room
Monitor how aggressively Perfect Ruler and Full Gas track Harswell River in the early stages
Observe if any of the hold-up horses can secure a prominent early position to avoid the inevitable squeeze
Check if Harswell River gets an easy lead or faces unexpected early pressure from the field
Watch for apprentice jockey Alex Jary's positioning on Maximum Velocity given the tactical complexities

races.paceDynamic: Secret Testimony will set the pace uncontested from the front, with Truly Special likely to track in second position through the early stages. With only one confirmed front runner in a field of nine, Secret Testimony can dictate comfortable fractions without pressure, though both he and Long Shot have shown tendencies to fade late. The lack of early pace pressure means the tempo will be steady rather than fierce, allowing closers time to organize their challenges. This race shape strongly favors hold-up horses who can stay on strongly, as they'll get the perfect setup from a measured gallop.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Closer's Paradise Setup
scenarios.trigger: If Secret Testimony sets uncontested fractions and fades as expected in the final furlong
scenarios.body: The soft pace allows hold-up horses to close strongly with Black Rock Beauty and Realistic Dream perfectly positioned to strike late. The highest-rated closers can exploit their class advantage over a tired leader.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Horse Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If Truly Special can track the pace and kick when Secret Testimony weakens
scenarios.body: Truly Special gets the perfect trip behind the leader and has enough tactical speed to respond when the race develops. The prominent running style proves optimal in avoiding trouble while staying close enough to strike.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Leader Holds On
scenarios.trigger: If Secret Testimony finds more stamina than recent form suggests and avoids his usual late fade
scenarios.body: The uncontested leader builds enough advantage through steady fractions to resist late challenges. His winning form at this trip earlier this year proves decisive despite recent disappointments.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Secret Testimony stops badly and Truly Special also struggles, leaving no early pace
scenarios.body: The race becomes a tactical crawl with no genuine pace-setters, turning into a sprint finish where class and track position matter most. The best-handicapped horses benefit from the chaotic finish.

watchPoints.text: Secret Testimony's jumping and early pace-setting will determine the entire race complexion - if he goes too fast early, it changes everything
Black Rock Beauty's fitness after 89 days off the track could be crucial given her prominent role in the betting
Truly Special's position tracking the leader will be vital - if he gets too keen or drops back, the race dynamics shift significantly
Long Shot and Secret Testimony both have fading tendencies that could create opportunities for late closers if both weaken together
The first three furlongs will reveal if this becomes the soft pace expected or if any hold-up horses force the issue early
